name: Virginia Steel & Fabrication
old_description: Virginia Steel & Fabrication stands as a cornerstone in the steel fabrication industry, dedicated to delivering exceptional services across the Appalachian region. With over 34 years of expertise, our company prides itself on its specialization in structural steel fabrication, conveyor systems, custom fabrication, and welding solutions. We cater to a diverse range of clients, from contractors to industrial facilities, ensuring precision and quality in every project we undertake. Our commitment to craftsmanship and reliable service has solidified our reputation as a trusted partner for both large and small scale projects.
about:
Virginia Steel & Fabrication operates from Bastian, Virginia, in the Appalachian region. The company was founded in 1992 on principles of craftsmanship and customer-focused service, with a focus on showing up to do the job right. No founders are named and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The shop provides structural steel fabrication, conveyor systems, custom fabrication, and welding solutions. It also offers design and detailing, project management, custom metal components such as railings, stairs, platforms, and ladders, and retail steel services including steel sales and custom cuts for contractors, businesses, and homeowners. The facility is described as equipped with advanced technology, though specific machinery and headcount are not disclosed.

The company serves contractors, mining operations, industrial facilities, and commercial projects across the Appalachian region. Its retail steel services also cater to homeowners and small businesses needing smaller quantities of steel.

Virginia Steel & Fabrication emphasizes its decades of experience, skilled craftsmen, advanced equipment, and a commitment to safety as key differentiators. The business was built on the idea of showing up to do the job right, with a focus on precision workmanship and dependable service.
